items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: Dinah sang. ... The singer was Dinah Washington ... And we had a piano player ... And that was -- we did about 15 states.

ctx.x: That must have been pretty good then.
(Inaudible) Dinah sang. George Jenkins was in the show and he did a special. I opened the second half with just the rhythm section one time.
